Republic Of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http://wvm.dilg.comph DILG OPINION No. 151 s. 2022 December 02, 2022 HON. CARLOS S. DE MESA Punong Barangay Barangay Duyan-Duyan Third District, Quezon City Dear PB De Mesa: This has reference to your letter dated 21 October 2022 addressed to Rep. Franz S. Pumaren, District Representative, Third District, Quezon City, requesting for assistance to fill in the vacancy created in the Sangguniang Barangay of Duyan-Duyan, Third District, Quezon City Per your representation, Sangguniang Barangay (SB) Member Maria Cristina B. Monasterio resigned sometime in April 2022. As a consequence of which, permanent vacancy arises in the Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay Duyan-Duyan, Third District, Quezon City. On the basis of Section 45(a)(3) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC), you sought to fill-in the vacancy by recommending Honoria S. Castuera as the replacement of then SB Member Monasterio. However, the six (6) remaining SB Members refused to concur with the proposed recommendation. Hence, your request to resolve the issue at hand. Foremost, the appointment to fill up a permanent vacancy upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay in the herein case is mandatory. This can be deduced in Section 45 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC), thus: "SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. — (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply Shal/ be filled by appointment in the following manner: (I) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the sangguniang pan/a/awigan and the sangguniang panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; (2) The govemor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concemed. " "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

aforementioned provision used the word "shall" in the phrase "...shal/be filledby appointment in the following manner..." It must be emphasized that the word "shall" connotes mandatory character; it indicates a word of command, and one which has always or which must be given a compulsory meaning, and it is generally imperative or mandatory in naturel. Likewise, the recommendation of the concerned sangguiang barangay in favor of the appointee is also mandatory being an element in the process of the appointment by the city or municipal mayor. However, we would like to emphasize that the aforequoted Section 45 (a)(3) of the LGC used the phrase "upon recommendation of the sangguniang concerned," not upon the recommendation of the Punong Barangay only. The Punong Barangay is only one of the members of the sangguniang barangay. The other 6 members of the sangguniang barangay refused to give their recommendation in favor of Castuera. It is settled that the sangguniang barangay acts as a collegial body where the decision of the majority prevails. In view of the foregoing, the Punong Barangay and Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay Duyan-Duyan are hereby advised to faithfully comply with the provisions of the LGC. Otherwise, noncompliance shall be tantamount to dereliction of duty or abuse of authority which is a ground for disciplinary action provided in Section 60 of the LGC. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BYA THORITY OF HE SECRETARY: . JUAN VICTOR R. LLAMAS n ersecretary for Extemal, Legal and Legislative Affairs ELWJWULS-LRALLD/rrao copy firniShea: DIR. MARIA LOURDES L.
